title: Well......
text: Well....... First of all, this book case is very heavy.  The good thing is, once we opened the box, there are smaller boxes inside so we could take the pieces in the house in multiple trips. The next thing we discovered, is that the ball bearings from one of the drawers had fallen out of slider/glider and fell all over the floor. Later during assembly, the glider/slider fell out of the drawer, too. So basically, one of our drawers doesn't open and close very well. Another issue is that there was a dent on one of the metal sides. All of those issues may have resulted during transit. Assembly took longer than expected. My husband puts together all kinds of furniture and is very handy. The directions were not always clear. For example, it we didn't know which way (up or down) to put the piece that the drawers go inside. My husband used his own tools such as an impact driver. From start to finish it took about two hours. The finished piece is sturdy and looks nice. The dented side faces the wall fortunately. Overall, it's okay.

product_metadata.title: CosmoLiving by Cosmopolitan Alfie Bookcase Gold
